BLUE SURGE: DEMOCRATS WIN HOUSE AND SENATE
Democrats capitalized on voter anger over Trump and affordability, flipping seats in deep-red and battleground states.

  • NBC News Exit Poll details how the blue tsunami took shape

  • Democrats take the House with dual goals: Investigate Trump and tackle affordability
    Just now15m ago

    Democrats will face a tricky challenge when they take control of the House and the Senate in January: carrying out aggressive oversight of Trump and his administration while needing his signature to advance just about any legislative goal.
